metadata.title: SOCRadar MSSP Alarms for Microsoft Sentinel
metadata.description: Multi-company bidirectional integration: imports SOCRadar alarms for several Company IDs into one Microsoft Sentinel workspace and syncs closed incidents back to the matching company. Includes optional audit logging, custom alarms table and Workbook dashboard.
metadata.author: SOCRadar

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics Workspace Name

Leave false to use a workspace that already exists: the workspace itself is not updated, so its pricing tier, retention and daily cap are never changed, and a name that does not exist fails before anything is created. Set true only to create a new workspace named WorkspaceName; do not set it on an existing workspace that uses a commitment tier. Only honoured when WorkspaceResourceGroup is the deployment resource group. An existing workspace in a different region than WorkspaceLocation fails the deployment with InvalidResourceLocation before anything is created.
Location/region of the Log Analytics workspace (e.g., centralus, northeurope). Must match your existing workspace region.
How often to check for new alarms (1-60 minutes)
How far back to look on first run (default: 600 = 10 hours)
Import all alarm statuses (OPEN, RESOLVED, MITIGATED, FALSE_POSITIVE). Default: only OPEN
Log all operations to Log Analytics for auditing
Store alarms in custom Log Analytics table (SOCRadar_MSSP_Alarms_CL) for analytics and KQL queries
Data retention in days for custom tables (30-730, default: 1 year)
Internal: Logic Apps start 3 min after deploy for role propagation
Resource group of existing Microsoft Sentinel workspace. Leave default if workspace is in same RG.
Microsoft Sentinel role for Logic Apps. Responder sufficient for incident ops (least-privilege).
Comma-separated SOCRadar Company IDs to monitor (e.g. 132,200,300). MSSP-scoped API key required (one key covering all listed companies).

Comma-separated human-readable company names matching CompanyIds positionally (e.g. Acme,Beta,Gamma). Appears as the [MSSP-<CompanyName>] prefix in incident titles and as the MSSP-<CompanyName> label.
Region for the Logic App and its API connection. Defaults to the resource group's region.

Push the Microsoft Sentinel incident severity back to SOCRadar when an incident is closed. Off by default: Microsoft Sentinel has no Critical severity, so a CRITICAL alarm imports as High and writing that back would silently downgrade the alarm on SOCRadar.

resources.comments: Resolves the existing workspace before any resource is created. A condition:false resource counts as a satisfied dependency in ARM, so depending on the Workspace resource itself does not stop the deployment when WorkspaceName does not exist and DeployNewWorkspace is false -- it would create the API connection, both Logic Apps, the workbook and the data collection endpoint and only then fail. This checks that the workspace EXISTS and nothing else. It does not check the deploying principal's write permission, and it cannot check whether the workspace already carries role assignments from an earlier install, which fail later with RoleAssignmentUpdateNotPermitted after resources have been created -- ARM can assert that a resource exists, not that it is absent.
resources.name: precheck-workspace-exists

resources.comments: Cross-RG only. Asserts that Microsoft Sentinel is onboarded on the external workspace. This template only creates the SecurityInsights solution and the onboarding state in its own resource group, so a cross-RG deployment onto a bare Log Analytics workspace deploys green and then imports nothing.
resources.name: precheck-external-workspace
